units.title: SG-1.2 Write pure grid-to-pixels and sprite-sheet functions
Act: Create gridToRgba in the frontend lib
Act: Create buildSpriteSheet in the frontend lib

tests.name: gridToRgba.test.ts > gridToRgba > dimensions and palette > returns width, height and RGBA data sized to the grid
tests.title: returns width, height and RGBA data sized to the grid
tests.scenario: Given a 3x2 grid, When converted, Then width=3, height=2 and data holds 24 bytes
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gridToRgba.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: gridToRgba.test.ts > gridToRgba > dimensions and palette > only emits palette colours with full alpha for every palette index
tests.title: only emits palette colours with full alpha for every palette index
tests.scenario: Given a grid using palette indices 0..47, When converted, Then each pixel maps to a PALETTE hex colour with alpha 255
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gridToRgba.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: gridToRgba.test.ts > gridToRgba > errors and determinism > throws when a palette index equals the palette length
tests.title: throws when a palette index equals the palette length
tests.scenario: Given [[PALETTE.length]], When converted, Then it throws
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gridToRgba.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: gridToRgba.test.ts > gridToRgba > errors and determinism > throws when a palette index is negative
tests.title: throws when a palette index is negative
tests.scenario: Given [[-1]], When converted, Then it throws
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gridToRgba.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: gridToRgba.test.ts > gridToRgba > errors and determinism > throws when a palette index is not an integer
tests.title: throws when a palette index is not an integer
tests.scenario: Given [[1.5]], When converted, Then it throws
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gridToRgba.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: gridToRgba.test.ts > gridToRgba > errors and determinism > throws when rows have different lengths
tests.title: throws when rows have different lengths
tests.scenario: Given ragged grid [[0,1],[0]], When converted, Then it throws
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gridToRgba.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: gridToRgba.test.ts > gridToRgba > errors and determinism > throws when the grid is empty
tests.title: throws when the grid is empty
tests.scenario: Given an empty grid [], When converted, Then it throws
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gridToRgba.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: gridToRgba.test.ts > gridToRgba > errors and determinism > produces identical pixel data when converting the same grid twice
tests.title: produces identical pixel data when converting the same grid twice
tests.scenario: Given the same grid, When converted twice, Then both results hold equal pixel data
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gridToRgba.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: size and count
tests.title: buildSpriteSheet size and layout: four 32x48 frames produce a 128x48 sheet with frameCount 4
tests.scenario: Given four 32x48 RGBA frames built from gridToRgba, When buildSpriteSheet is called, Then the sheet is 128x48 with frameWidth 32, frameHeight 48, frameCount 4
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/spriteSheet.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: placement
tests.title: buildSpriteSheet size and layout: each frame i is drawn at x offset i*32 with its palette colour
tests.scenario: Given frame i filled with palette index i, When the sheet is built, Then the pixel at (i*32+5, 10) equals the RGB of PALETTE[i]
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/spriteSheet.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: palette
tests.title: buildSpriteSheet palette, errors, determinism: every pixel of the 4-frame sheet is a PALETTE colour
tests.scenario: Given the 4-frame sheet, When every pixel's RGB is read, Then each one is in the set of PALETTE colours
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/spriteSheet.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: errors (empty)
tests.title: buildSpriteSheet palette, errors, determinism: an empty frame list throws
tests.scenario: Given an empty frames array, When buildSpriteSheet is called, Then it throws
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/spriteSheet.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: errors (mismatched sizes)
tests.title: buildSpriteSheet palette, errors, determinism: frames of 2x2 and 3x2 in one sheet throw
tests.scenario: Given a 2x2 frame and a 3x2 frame, When buildSpriteSheet is called, Then it throws
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/spriteSheet.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: determinism
tests.title: buildSpriteSheet palette, errors, determinism: two calls on the same frames give equal pixel data
tests.scenario: Given the same four frames, When buildSpriteSheet is called twice, Then Array.from(data) is equal for both results
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/spriteSheet.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: non-mutation
tests.title: buildSpriteSheet palette, errors, determinism: input frame data arrays are unchanged after the call
tests.scenario: Given four frames with recorded data, When buildSpriteSheet is called, Then each frame's data is unchanged
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/spriteSheet.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

units.title: REQ · gridToRgba converts a palette-indexed grid to RGBA and rejects out-of-range indices
REQ · buildSpriteSheet lays equal-size frames into one horizontal sheet with size and frame metadata
